claims.statement: Regulatory jobs extend the canonical missions model; no parallel scheduler or source of truth is introduced.
A canonical mission can persist job name, mining mode, novelty baseline, scope, authority allowlist, change types and bounded result limit; the same profile is supplied to AI planning and discovery.
Panoramica exposes Regulatory Research and Events as equal role-aware lanes. A compact recommendation may signal urgency but does not remove either process.
Workbench endpoints are read-only semantic projections of canonical runtime records and do not create a parallel scheduler or data model.
The bootstrap response projects a canonical server-issued access profile describing identity, capabilities, prohibited actions, state effects and evidence.
A read-only role-aware support surface explains architecture, journeys, terminology, benchmark mappings, runtime proof and limitations while presenting summary before full detail.
The final cascade resolves legacy visual aliases onto canonical tokens and provides explicit focus, target, reflow, reduced-motion and forced-colors baselines.
Core labels follow object, state, action and effect; secondary why, how, AI, authority and evidence detail remains reachable through native disclosure or internal dialog.
Material intake exposes Link, Text and Document modes through one canonical entry point while preserving original material separately from enrichment and source decisions.
Administration presents posture first and moves usage, governance and directory detail into independent disclosures without adding a new write workflow.
Auditor access remains read-only and exposes evidence through the active auditor identity.
The repository contains an executable 18-dimension enterprise assurance model.
The ICTC 1.4 experience model remains a regression contract.
The 1.6 model remains a regression model with M+100 and N+100 zero novelty.
ICTC 1.7 remains a regression contract for deterministic routing, summary-first pages and M+100 no-novelty assurance.
ICTC 1.8 balances both core processes, models governed regulatory jobs, exposes one material intake, compacts event queues and validates 12 T dimensions with zero novelty at each M+100 tail.
Deployment certification and complete regulatory discovery require external identity, TLS, storage, backup, malware scanning, observability, accessibility and domain evidence.
